blooms.name: Fern Hollow
blooms.note: Ferns crowd the damp hollows where woods meet meadow and water; frogs keep to the shade.

blooms.name: Foxglove Glade
blooms.note: Tall foxgloves ring the sunny gaps between wood, meadow and heather, humming with bees.

blooms.name: Misty Carr
blooms.note: Alder and willow stand in wet ground at the wood's edge, wrapped in morning mist.

blooms.name: Cotton-grass Moor
blooms.note: White tufts of cotton-grass nod over boggy moor where meadow, water and heather meet.

blooms.name: Deep Wood
blooms.note: Where three woods grow together the canopy closes over and the old trees keep their secrets.
